safety_verdicts.content: Patient reports a tingling sensation around the lips.
safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold specifies tingling around the lips; generated documents throat tingling instead and does not mention lip tingling.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Peri-oral (lip) tingling is a potentially relevant early symptom in an allergic reaction/anaphylaxis and helps characterize mucosal involvement. However, the note still captures a similar red-flag symptom (throat tingling/closing sensation) and the clinician’s disposition (urgent ambulance/hospital) would be unlikely to change based on lip vs throat tingling location alone.

safety_verdicts.eval_reasoning: Gold mentions possibility of urticaria/hives; generated assessment does not mention urticaria.
safety_verdicts.clinical_rationale: Omitting the possibility of urticaria/hives reduces completeness of the differential but does not remove the higher-risk assessment (possible anaphylaxis) or the appropriate urgent escalation to emergency care. This is primarily a documentation/coding nuance with minimal expected impact on immediate management in this context.
